{{Quote|Your lightsaber is an invaluable tool. Even when inactive, it can defuse a potentially volatile situation. Trust me on that.|[[Kyle Katarn]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>}}
'''Battlemaster''' was the title for the premier [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] [[Jedi instructor|instructor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi academy]]. Appointed by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], the Battlemaster oversaw all lightsaber instruction at the academy, and was responsible for electing new instructors. While there was only one Battlemaster at any given time following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Order's satellite academies each received a respective head instructor, all of whom reported to and were hand-picked by the Battlemaster of the Jedi Order on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
[[File:Jedi_Master_versus_two_Sith.jpg|thumb|right|279x279px|Kao Cen Darach, Battlemaster before the Cold War]]
When the academy on Coruscant was founded, the Jedi High Council elected a Battlemaster to lead instruction in the art of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] technique. For several generations there existed only a single Battlemaster at a time.<ref name="TJP" /> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]], the title of Battlemaster was given to Jedi who had gone above and beyond in combat during the conflicts. In these years, [[Jun Seros (Jedi)|Jun Seros]] served as a Battlemaster of the Jedi Order, replacing the deceased [[Kao Cen Darach]].<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> After the [[Revanite crisis]] ended, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]], was bestowed the title of Battlemaster. All this ended with the start of the [[New Sith Wars]]. Although [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Lord Hoth]] had ascended to the official position of Battlemaster of the Jedi Order,<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> with the vast majority of Jedi serving on the battlefronts and learning lightsaber technique on the front lines, the [[Jedi Lord|lords]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|generals]] of the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] were declaring themselves Battlemasters as they showed prowess against the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]]' warriors. When the war ended at [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|Ruusan]], the Army was dissolved and the war-weary Jedi returned to Coruscant. While many revoked the title and took up roles as instructors, others were sent out to satellite training facilities to lead instruction on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. A few years after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] took effect, Master [[Skarch Vaunk]] was serving as the head Battlemaster of the Jedi Order.<ref name="TJP" />

[[File:CinDrallig-SWCTP.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]], Battlemaster during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].]]By the last days of the Republic, Master [[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]] led the academy's lightsaber instruction, teaching master swordsmen as [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. It should be noted that while there existed only one Battlemaster, there existed a select few that served as lightsaber combat instructors, either as heads of lesser academies or serving directly beneath the Battlemaster. One such example was the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] Master [[Kirlocca]], who taught lightsaber techniques to the students of the [[Almas Academy]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], serving as one of the appointed lightsaber instructors under the authority of the Battlemaster.<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Other such appointed lightsaber instructors active under the respective Battlemaster included [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]], and [[Anoon Bondara]]. At the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Drallig was killed by one of his greatest students, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], a former Knight who was seduced to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Drallig's death ended the line of Battlemasters, as the Order was soon after disbanded.<ref name="ROTS" />

[[File:KamSolusar-NEGTC.png|thumb|right|150px|[[Kam Solusar]], Battlemaster during the early years of the reformed Order.]]
Following the ensuing [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Master [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] began efforts to begin rebuilding the [[New Jedi Order|Order]], and eventually raised the first class of the next generation of Jedi Knights. Because of his prior experiences in lightsaber combat as a former member of the [[Dark Side Elite]], [[Kam Solusar]] was appointed head of combat instruction at the [[Jedi Praxeum]]. During Solusar's years as the head lightsaber instructor, Solusar educated the earliest [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] by creating the [[three rings of defense]], the new Order's basic defensive principles. Kam Solusar would retain this title until after the defeat of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Desann]], when the title of Battlemaster was bestowed upon Master [[Kyle Katarn]], circa [[13 ABY/Legends|13]]/[[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]]. Katarn, who was already an experienced fencer, was known for introducing the three combat styles&mdash;the [[Fast style|Fast]], [[Medium style|Medium]], and [[Strong style|Strong]] styles&mdash;of the Order, complete with their own Katas and maneuvers, encompassing techniques specific for single, dual, or even [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] combat.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:JediWeaponMaster.jpg|thumb|left|130px|A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Sword/Legends|sword]] master.]]
It is a strong possibility that [[Anoon Bondara]] was the Jedi Battlemaster prior to Cin Drallig. In both of Anoon's appearances he is described as having lightsaber skills second to none, also the fact that he was the lightsaber instructor to Younglings and Padawans such as [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and that he died in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the same year Cin Drallig became Battlemaster, support this possibility. However, it is unknown whether or not he was the head lightsaber instructor at the Temple and therefore the Battlemaster.

There is also a possibility that the [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] Jedi Master [[Raskta Lsu]] was the Battlemaster of her generation, as she had mastered all forms of lightsaber combat and was noted as to being the greatest duelist of her time. [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]], the co-creator of the infamous [[Form VII/Legends#Vaapad|Vaapad]], was credited as being a master of every known form of lightsaber combat.

He was so proficient with the [[Lightsaber/Legends|weapon of a Jedi]] that Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] commissioned Sora's help in creating Vaapad. As one of the Order's greatest lightsaber instructors, Sora Bulq was credited with training a great many students over the years. Sora was an active Jedi during the time Cin Drallig was the head lightsaber instructor at the Jedi Temple (before he fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]), so it is probable that he was not the premier Battlemaster, but rather one of a select few.
